shortDescription: China's yuan midpoint weakened to 6.7795 per U.S. dollar on Monday, down 8 pips from the previous trading day and ending a two-session rise, according to ETNet.The fixing was 709 pips weaker than Reuters' estimate and marked the largest gap since February 27. The previous midpoint was 6.7787.
